title: Why is N3on becoming an AI streamer? Kick star defends controversial never-ending livestream
summary_full: On September 7, 2026, Kick streamer N3on unveiled a groundbreaking AI streaming initiative that aims to make him the first AI streamer with an uninterrupted broadcast. This pioneering project is designed to operate continuously, even when N3on is offline. He positions this venture as an exciting evolution in content creation while reassuring fans that his traditional streaming will persist alongside this new experiment.
